thread:
maria: Seeing a new flurry of stream 'idle' alerts after the console change.
kevin: Yep noticed a small uptick this morning.
maria: Streams look alive on logs though — bytes are flowing, but console marks them idle.
kevin: Any chance the console is sampling based on chunk boundaries? proxies can coalesce.
jess: It might be that we treat no parsed JSON events as idle. But we send non-JSON "comment" keepalives like ": keepalive\n\n".
kevin: exact. curl -N reproducer:
```
curl -s -N "$URL/stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# server writes periodically: ":\n\n" (comment) then real event payloads
```
matthew: Some edge proxies merge tiny chunks -> long silence then big payload -> console flags idle then a big burst shows up.
jess: console sampling uses last_successful_parse_ts, not raw byte receipts. comment-lines never increment that.
maria: So we have false 'idle' followed by billing spike on burst. not great.
kevin: Two options:
1) server: write explicit tiny JSON heartbeats `{ "hb": 1 }` — but clients may rely on event schema.
2) telemetry: consider any non-empty chunk as activity and reset idle timer (safer but proxy-coalesce caveat).
matthew: Also could annotate chunks with a header `X-Stream-Chunk: seq` so console can detect chunk boundaries even if body coalesced.
jess: I like header idea for internal streams. Lightweight and non-breaking.
maria: quick patch idea: treat colon-prefixed comments as keepalives in console AND expose a confidence flag in the UI "probable keepalive".
ops-bot: deploy queued: feature/stream-annotate -> canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC :rocket:
kevin: I'll pick up server-side header annotation (maria + kevin pair).
jess: I'll change console idle logic to respect comment-keepalive and add UI confidence label.
matthew: I'll add a small integration test that simulates coalescing proxies and checks alerting.
maria: TL;DR: implement X-Stream-Chunk for internal routes, console treats comment-only chunks as keepalive, canary next day. :thumbsup:
kevin: Filed issue #4321 with repro + runbook.
jess: added console PR draft at https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/987 :eyes:
ops-bot: Note: rollout flag = `stream_chunk_annotate` set to off for external prod by default.
maria: Thanks all — let's sync after canary.
